name: LTM Ltd
title: LTM Ltd - 540005 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: IT services read: Q4 USD revenue +1.2% QoQ and 8.1% YoY, but no numeric FY27 guidance and margin fell 100bp QoQ to 15.1% on wage hikes; supply signals are absent, so this is a demand-and-pricing story with hedged tone.

utilisation.quote: Our utilization, excluding trainees, stood at 85.7% for the quarter, compared to 86.9% in Q3.

triggers.label: Utilisation 86.9% → 85.7%
triggers.quote: Our utilization, excluding trainees, stood at 85.7% for the quarter, compared to 86.9% in Q3.

triggers.label: Q4 EBIT margin down 100bp QoQ
triggers.quote: Q4 operating EBIT margin declined by 100 -basis points sequentially to 15.1%.

triggers.label: Q4 order inflow USD 1.7bn
triggers.quote: Order inflow remains stable, closing at US D 1.7 billion. This marks our sixth consecutive quarter with inflows exceeding USD 1.5 billion.

triggers.label: Top BFSI account decline, bottoming
triggers.quote: in Q1 onwards, I would expect the growth trajectory will begin for that particular account. It is just that the recovery acceleration will not match the speed of the decline

guidance.value: No numeric guidance; management says 'continue our growth momentum for the full year'
guidance.quote: I see no reason than to believe that we will continue the same growth momentum that we have built in the entire FY2026 that will flow into FY2027.

guidance.value: Double revenue in five years (~15% CAGR)
guidance.quote: I am looking at doubling down the revenue in five years.

red_flags.label: Management refuses numeric FY27 guidance
red_flags.quote: as you would know that we do not give any specific guidance number.

evasions.quote: I would not like to give a specific number as guidance in terms of what we are targeting
There may be one or two quarters where we will go through, a sort of softness
